info.name: Sitecore CDP REST Audit Products API

params.name: search
params.description: Full-text search term to filter results

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items to return per page (max 100)

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Field name to sort results by; prefix with ! to sort descending

items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of products from the OrderCloud catalog. Supports full-text search, filtering by any product field, sorting, and pagination. Results include product metadata, pricing references, and extended properties.

Creates a new product in the OrderCloud catalog. Products support flexible extended properties (xp), variant generation via specs, and inventory tracking. Products must be assigned to a catalog before buyers can see or purchase them.

params.name: productID
params.description: The unique identifier of the product

items.docs: Retrieves a specific product by its identifier. Returns full product details including description, price schedule assignment, inventory configuration, and extended properties.

items.docs: Performs a full replacement update of a product. All fields are replaced with the values in the request body. Use PATCH for partial updates.

params.name: productID
params.description: The unique identifier of the product

items.docs: Performs a partial update of a product. Only the fields provided in the request body are updated; all other fields retain their current values.
